compatibilityWorkRequired: The official Linux serve.sh assumes NVIDIA/SGLang and failed on a CPU-only host; the documented GGUF llama-server command was started manually.
The published PyPI 1.1.37 MCP schema requires args, while the current repository example omitted args for one server.
The PyPI pptagent-mcp ignores CONFIG_FILE and required explicit PPTAGENT_MODEL, PPTAGENT_API_BASE, and PPTAGENT_API_KEY environment entries.
Windows Docker could not mount a WSL /home path. DEEPPRESENTER_WORKSPACE_BASE and DEEPPRESENTER_HOST_WORKSPACE_BASE were set to paired /mnt/c and C:/ paths.
WSL Node.js and LibreOffice/poppler had to be installed separately.

failure.reason: The CPU design pass generated nine slides over roughly two hours, then a single model request exceeded the framework's 30-minute API timeout.
failure.qualityObserved: Slide 1 already contains clipped title and body text. Early inspect_slide calls failed before Node.js was installed, so reflective layout correction did not run on those slides.
failure.decision: The process was stopped after the timeout. The nine original HTML files are retained without hand-fixing; no PPTX is claimed.

speakerNotes.detail: No presenter or speaker-notes artifact was produced before the run failed.
